description: Returns the current site's Service Worker Settings (from the Advanced Settings page), using the dashboard labels: enable_service_worker_registration ("Enable the service worker registration from PushEngage"), enable_service_worker_in_subfolder ("Enable addition of service worker in another sub-folder"), and service_worker_file_path ("Path for service worker file").
name: pushengage_get_service_worker_settings
title: Get service worker settings
